title: Crime hotspot dynamics in residential burglary models with police response
summary: We develop and analyze mathematical models for residential burglary that incorporates police deployment through a delayed feedback mechanism. Motivated by empirical observations from publicly available crime and policing data, we extend a well-known agent-based model by introducing a dynamic police response driven by crime information that becomes available only after a finite delay.
